literal: Earth possessors' support secured even when, laziness possessors excellent benefit attaining is difficult.
translation: Even if they secure the support of kings who rule the earth, it is difficult for the lazy to attain any glorious benefits.
modern: உலகத்தை ஆளும் அரசர்களின் ஆதரவு கிடைத்தாலும், சோம்பல் உடையவர்கள் சிறந்த பயன்களை அடைவது கடினம்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes that external advantages cannot compensate for internal flaws like laziness. The word 'paṭi' means the earth, and 'paṭiyuṭaiyār' refers to kings or powerful rulers who possess it. Even if a person secures the strong support ('paṟṟu') of such powerful figures, their own laziness ('maṭi') will prevent them from achieving any excellent results ('māṇ payan'). True success requires personal effort, regardless of how much backing one has.
